purpose: One deterministic planar remesh of the bottom exterior disk on the frozen local_b_0p25mm analytic fixture.

method.scope: Replace only the z=0 bottom fan triangulation; retain its exact 128-vertex polygon boundary and the same planar surface.
method.interior_point_layout: Deterministic 1.0 mm triangular lattice, clipped to the existing convex polygon with a 0.40 mm boundary margin; one SciPy/Qhull Delaunay triangulation; no random jitter or adaptive escalation.
method.surface_chart: World XY in millimeters at z=0, identified by bottom_exterior_z0.
method.relief_and_shape: All old rest/relief coordinates remain a bitwise-identical prefix. New points lie in the existing planar polygon and have rest_xyz == relief_xyz with z=0.
method.color: Sample the frozen base_linear_rgb field at every new floor vertex and every source/output patch vertex. Require local-B outer_base_linear_rgb to match frozen baseline outer_color_linear_rgb in shape, dtype, and bytes; this preserved vertex table can be patterned and is not the scalar base pigment. Preserve every existing outer relief/color/chart array bitwise and compare point-sampled outer_color_linear_rgb at its corners plus finite edge-midpoint/centroid samples against the frozen continuous field, including sRGB checks.
method.lineage_schema: Quarantined experiment-only schema v2 with no production integration. A floor child face fully contained in one baseline fan triangle may store valid data under v2_legacy_single_parent_face_source_ids and v2_legacy_single_parent_face_corner_barycentric_to_source. Cross-parent faces use -1/NaN only in those explicitly named v2 legacy-single-parent arrays, plus clipped parent patches. Each patch records baseline source face, intersection area, intersection vertices in XY, barycentric coordinates in both source and output faces, and field-sampled linear/sRGB color. Patches must cover the output face with no positive-area overlap. The per-output-face record ceiling is the complete frozen 128-parent fan, not an arbitrary smaller sector count: a child triangle incident to the retained center can geometrically cross many narrow radial sectors (about 21–22 sectors across a 60-degree span at 2.8125 degrees per sector). This is a geometric bookkeeping rationale, not a generated-output observation or quality target. The standard schema-v1 source_face_ids and face_corner_barycentric_to_source keys are omitted from the saved candidate, so consumers requiring either key should fail closed with KeyError. Compatibility with legacy consumers is UNKNOWN; metadata does not enforce reader behavior.
method.quarantine: EXPERIMENT_ONLY_NOT_FOR_PRODUCTION; no production reader/writer integration is authorized by this source review.
method.fixture_semantics: Analytic synthetic fixture only; geometric triangle quality does not establish tet quality, solver h, mechanics, fragment identity, or material calibration.

focused_checks: All input SHA pins, case freeze, baseline provenance, and expected topology are verified before generation.

The preserved local-B outer-base color table is byte-identical to the frozen baseline outer-color table; it is not compared to the scalar base pigment. Actual sampled outer continuous-field color and sRGB checks remain active.
All original candidate vertices, outer chart samples, relief, colors, and normals remain bitwise equal by ID; the 128-vertex floor boundary is unchanged.
The remeshed disk is the same convex polygon: area, interface cycle, orientation, and whole-mesh closed two-manifold topology are checked.
Every new floor vertex is independently reconstructed from its frozen baseline source triangle and barycentric coordinates.
Every floor patch has positive area; source/output barycentric reconstruction passes; patch area covers its output face; pairwise patch intersections have zero area within tolerance.

The readback derives the frozen parent fan from baseline geometry, checks the saved fan declaration, and caps each output face at that complete 128-face fan with unique parent patches; global patch-record, patch-vertex, and wall-clock budgets remain fixed.

Every floor vertex/patch color is compared in linear RGB and sRGB with source-position field samples; finite global outer-field samples are compared with local-B, including an explicit unchanged relief-sample-error delta gate.
Actual displaced-coordinate triangle Q/aspect are reported globally and for floor/nonfloor regions; floor and global minimum-Q/maximum-aspect must improve over input.
The saved-mesh global PNG uses equal physical axis scaling and flat triangles; an equal-aspect floor view exposes the actual remesh.

candidate_targets_for_root_review.note: These are experiment review targets for this candidate, not general mesh or mechanics standards.

finite_budget.per_output_face_patch_limit_basis: Complete frozen bottom source fan; lineage bookkeeping bound only, not a geometric quality threshold.
finite_budget.on_budget_or_check_failure: Write a bounded failure/unknown receipt when possible, stop the only candidate, and do not alter pitch, margin, thresholds, or retry with another density.
